Physical section:

Once each of these evaluations is made, the trained clinician 
proﬁ cient in nutrition physical assessment determines a global 
physical scoring (well-nourished or moderately or severely mal-
nourished) using criteria outlined in Box 5. Triaging nutrition
intervention is then determined using the information provided
in Box 6.
